entry_points.role: The Ruby entry point for every `ots` command. Parses the global `-v`/`--verbose`, `-D`/`--debug` and `--safe-boot` switches, then dispatches to the command registry.

entry_points.role: Operator front door for installing from a checkout. Wraps `bin/setup`; `--reconcile` re-derives child keys and re-applies broker policies. Idempotent, and it never regenerates a live `SECRET`.
